content.text:
{
  "hazard_consequence_node": [
    {
      "label": "HazardConsequence",
      "name": "Toxicity dispersion",
      "node_id": "H1",
      "node_type": "HazardConsequence",
      "evidence": "“On February 12, 2014, two employees ... suffered first and second degree chemical burns ... concentrated sulfuric acid sprayed two workers following a mechanical integrity failure ... This resulted in the release of approximately 84,000 pounds of sulfuric acid.”",
      "explanation": "The incident centers on a large loss of containment of sulfuric acid that sprayed workers and released hazardous acid to the environment for over two hours. No ignition, fire, explosion, or oxygen-deficient atmosphere occurred. Among the allowed categories, Toxicity dispersion is the best fit for this harmful chemical release mechanism.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "entity_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "Sulfuric acid",
      "node_id": "En1",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "concentrated sulfuric acid sprayed two workers",
      "explanation": "Sulfuric acid was the hazardous material released from the sampling system and it directly caused the workers' chemical burn injuries.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "Sulfuric acid sampling station in the alkylation unit",
      "node_id": "En2",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "at the sulfuric acid sampling station",
      "explanation": "The loss of containment occurred at the sulfuric acid sampling station within the refinery alkylation unit.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "condition_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Phase",
      "name": "Liquid",
      "node_id": "C1",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "concentrated sulfuric acid sprayed two workers",
      "explanation": "The released sulfuric acid was in liquid form and sprayed from the failed tubing connection.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Pressure",
      "name": "Low pressure",
      "node_id": "C2",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "operating below 100 pounds per square inch gauge (psig)",
      "explanation": "The source vessel was operating below 100 psig, indicating a relatively low-pressure release rather than a high-pressure event.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Temperature",
      "name": "Atmospheric temperature",
      "node_id": "C3",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "near the ambient temperature of approximately 50 degrees Fahrenheit",
      "explanation": "The sulfuric acid was released near ambient conditions rather than at unusually high or low process temperature.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Volatility",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C4",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident report does not explicitly state the volatility classification of the released material.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Combustibility",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C5",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The incident report does not explicitly state the combustibility classification of the released sulfuric acid.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "ToxicSubstance",
      "name": "Toxic",
      "node_id": "C6",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "acid fumes are harmful if inhaled",
      "explanation": "The report describes sulfuric acid fumes as harmful if inhaled and the released acid caused worker injuries, supporting classification as a toxic substance.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Asphyxiant",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C7",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The report does not identify sulfuric acid as an asphyxiant or describe oxygen-displacement effects.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Conductivity",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C8",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The electrical conductivity of the released material is not stated in the incident report.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "ReleaseType",
      "name": "Continuous release",
      "node_id": "C9",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "acid continued to spray out of the failed tubing for over two hours",
      "explanation": "The sulfuric acid discharge continued for an extended period until responders isolated the system, so the release was continuous rather than instantaneous.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Confinement",
      "name": "Not specified",
      "node_id": "C10",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "N/A",
      "explanation": "The report does not explicitly classify the release area in terms of confinement.",
      "source": "Not specified"
    },
    {
      "label": "Dispersion",
      "name": "Dispersed",
      "node_id": "C11",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "spraying the two operators with acid",
      "explanation": "The failed connection produced an acid spray that dispersed hazardous material into the surrounding work area.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "event_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "InitiatingEvent",
      "name": "Opening the valve to return the sulfuric acid sampling system to service following maintenance",
      "node_id": "Ev1",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "The incident occurred when the operators opened a valve to return an acid sampling system back to service.",
      "explanation": "The initiating event was the start-up action that reintroduced sulfuric acid into the repaired sampling system.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "MechanicalFailure",
      "name": "¾-inch stainless steel tubing connector came apart due to insufficient tightening at a compression joint",
      "node_id": "Ev2",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "failure of a ¾-inch diameter stainless steel tubing connector that came apart due to insufficient tightening between a tube and a compression joint",
      "explanation": "This connector failure was the direct mechanical integrity breakdown that caused the sulfuric acid loss of containment.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ]
}
